project: Sounding v1 — the blend probe deployed on natural rows (pilot S1)
committed_before_analysis: TRUE — sealed before any natural-row instance is generated. No violation rate on a natural row exists at sealing time.
instrument: Geometry Probe A, QUALIFIED 2026-07-26 under prereg_v16 (battery exact 4072/4072; sampled sensitivity >= 0.987 at budget 100)

what_this_is.statement: the qualified probe taken to the population it was built for: natural problems, where closure anatomy is underivable for 317 of 345 rows.
what_this_is.and_named_plainly: this is the LEGITIMATE REVIVAL of Terroir-C's question — does measured solution-space geometry predict cited charges? — on a NEW INSTRUMENT and a NEW POPULATION. New seal, new census. Nothing sealed shut is reopened: Terroir-C stays INSUFFICIENT-as-sealed on its own population, and prereg_v15's verdict is untouched.
what_this_is.the_honest_cost: the probe needs, per problem, an instance generator AND a solution enumerator. That is per-row engineering, which is why this is a pilot and not a fleet.

1_distinct_tuples_only.rule: every violation rate is computed over ALL-DISTINCT m-subsets of the region, and ships beside r (the solution count), the number of distinct m-subsets, and the uniform-tuple cap r(r-1)...(r-m+1)/r^m for reference.
1_distinct_tuples_only.why: the deflator species (methods 35) dies at the schema level. Blend operations are idempotent on repeats, so a tuple containing a repeat cannot violate; a rate over uniform tuples is mechanically capped and its SHAPE is forced by the denominator. The typed null is built in, not retrofitted.

2_encoding_rule.rule: the probe applies to any row whose per-instance solutions encode as FIXED-LENGTH VECTORS — vertex subsets as characteristic vectors, assignments directly.
2_encoding_rule.excluded: permutation-structured rows (TSP tours and kin) ship as `n.a.-encoding`. Typed out, not forced.

3_region_declaration.decision_rows: the region is the full solution set.
3_region_declaration.optimization_rows: TWO regions, measured separately and NEVER pooled: the FEASIBLE set and the OPTIMAL set. They have different geometry — feasible vertex covers are union-tolerant, optimal ones are not — and conflating them would be the region-choice version of the wrong-question error.

design_laws_inherited_and_applied_from_b.4_ensembles_declared_per_row: generator family, parameters, sizes small enough for exhaustive solution enumeration, seeds, instance counts. All F2-typed: ensemble-relative, never impersonating worst-case charges.

THE_FORCED_ARM_NAMED_BEFORE_RUNNING.statement: S-1 is THEOREM-FORCED on CSP rows and on feasible regions, and is calibration only.
THE_FORCED_ARM_NAMED_BEFORE_RUNNING.why: if Gamma is closed under f then EVERY instance's solution set is closed under f — that is what a polymorphism IS. So a 2-SAT instance's solution set is majority-closed by theorem, and a feasible vertex-cover set is union-closed by theorem (Gamma = {OR2} is max-closed). Agreement there verifies the generator, the enumerator and the encoding. It earns nothing beyond that.
THE_FORCED_ARM_NAMED_BEFORE_RUNNING.what_is_NOT_forced: the OPTIMAL regions. An optimal set is a sub-level set of an objective over a solution set, not the solution set of a CSP, so its closure is not forced by any polymorphism. Optimal-region geometry is genuinely measured.
THE_FORCED_ARM_NAMED_BEFORE_RUNNING.sealed_so_it_cannot_be_discovered: the same trap as prereg_v16's exhaustive arm, named in advance for the same reason.

pilot_population_S1.target: 12-18 rows, chosen for generator cheapness and family spread
pilot_population_S1.calibration_overlap_required: rows also carrying Marrow's derived closure columns are the natural-side known-answer battery. 14 of the planned rows qualify (engine_type_natural derived at prereg_v15 M2).

S1_calibration.claim: on rows with derived closure facts, the probe's violation profile agrees with the known engine type: XOR-SAT near-zero minority-violation; 2-SAT near-zero majority-violation; Horn semilattice-quiet (min); 3-SAT / NAE / 1-in-3 loud on every flavour.
S1_calibration.threshold: on a theorem-forced pairing the rate must be EXACTLY 0.0 — the closure is guaranteed, so any nonzero value is an instrument, encoding or enumerator bug.

S2_the_mechanism_question.claim: measured violation profiles separate decision-easy from decision-hard rows above a family-blind null
S2_the_mechanism_question.direction_sealed: HARDER ROWS LOUDER — higher violation rates on decision-hard rows

S3_the_discriminator_from_birth.claim: S-2's separation, if any, evaluated INSIDE the largest family against within-family nulls
S3_the_discriminator_from_birth.expected: n will be thin. INSUFFICIENT is legal and expected on most families; declared per family, never argued past.
S3_the_discriminator_from_birth.why_from_birth: Terroir had to bolt this on after a headline existed. Here it is sealed before the headline can.

S4_registry.claim: probe-feature predictions are filed for any open cells in scope BEFORE any literature work touches them, per the standing predict-then-fill protocol

kill_criteria.generator_floor: fewer than 12 pilot rows with a working generator AND enumerator inside the box -> ship the GENERATOR CENSUS as the finding ('the probe's reach on the natural corpus is N rows at current cost'). No forcing.
kill_criteria.fleet_expansion: more rows, bigger ensembles — a SEPARATE authorisation gated on this pilot's verdict. Not granted here.

standing_discipline.distribution_shape_rule: any shape claim about the profiles states its typed null IN THE SAME BREATH (methods 35).
standing_discipline.gates: meta-gate and tidy-number gates live on the new artifacts; results carry computed values only, constants in `_meta` with `literal: true`.
standing_discipline.frozen_bytes: untouched. No charge cell is written; no atlas or anatomy artifact is modified.

the_stake_recorded_without_assuming_it.if_S1_passes_and_S2_S3_show_residual: the mechanism programme has its first positive on the population that was always missing
the_stake_recorded_without_assuming_it.if_S1_passes_and_S2_is_null: measured geometry joins surface features in the doesn't-predict pile — a clean, powered negative on fresh ground
the_stake_recorded_without_assuming_it.either_way: the 317 locked rooms get their first instrument reading
